recognize_zh: 表皮基底層與棘層內可見多個核深染、帶透明暈（halo）的淋巴球單個散入表皮，沿基底層排列，但表皮海綿狀水腫不明顯，真皮乳頭層有淋巴球浸潤，這是蕈狀肉芽腫的表皮趨向性（epidermotropism）。
features: Single lymphocytes infiltrating the basal and lower spinous layers of the epidermis
Intraepidermal lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, slightly irregular nuclei and perinuclear clear halos
Lymphocytes aligned along the basal layer
Epidermotropism out of proportion to minimal spongiosis
Papillary dermis with edema/fibrosis and a lymphoid infiltrate containing some larger atypical cells
describe_en: Skin biopsy at medium-high power shows lymphocytes infiltrating the epidermis singly, mainly along the basal layer and in the lower spinous layer. The intraepidermal lymphocytes have hyperchromatic, mildly irregular nuclei surrounded by clear halos, and spongiosis is minimal relative to the number of lymphocytes. The papillary dermis contains a lymphoid infiltrate with scattered larger atypical cells. Findings demonstrate epidermotropism of haloed atypical lymphocytes and are consistent with mycosis fungoides, pending clinicopathologic correlation and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Exocytosis of lymphocytes in dermatitis is accompanied by prominent spongiosis and the lymphocytes lack halos and nuclear atypia.
Interface dermatitis shows vacuolar basal damage and necrotic keratinocytes, whereas MF lymphocytes line the basal layer with little keratinocyte injury.
Pityriasis lichenoides has a wedge-shaped infiltrate, necrotic keratinocytes, and extravasated RBCs with parakeratosis, rather than haloed atypical basilar lymphocytes.
